description: Live Progress Panel — a persistent right-hand sidebar on every project page showing milestone completion for Trend Mapper, Value Designer, and SPI agents. Milestones derived from message counts and agent workflow specs. Auto-updates as conversation progresses. Shows recent topics and a Next Step recommendation aligned with the FUND II course arc.

userStories.title: Milestone definitions and progress computation utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a pure TypeScript utility that defines per-agent milestones and computes completion status from a messages array, so the ProgressPanel can stay free of logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/progress/milestones.ts (no server-only — must be importable on client)

Export AGENT_MILESTONES: record keyed by agentKey ('trend-mapper' | 'value-designer' | 'spi') each with { label: string, milestones: Array<{ id: string, label: string, minAssistantMessages: number }> }

Trend Mapper milestones (matches messages where agentType == null): 1) 'Trend topic chosen' at 2 msgs 2) 'Evidence documented' at 5 msgs 3) 'Drivers & implications mapped' at 9 msgs 4) 'Opportunity & HMW framed' at 13 msgs 5) 'Slide export unlocked' at 4 msgs

Value Designer milestones (agentType === 'value-designer'): 1) 'User persona defined' at 4 msgs 2) 'Problem deep-dive complete' at 8 msgs 3) 'Job-to-be-Done crafted' at 12 msgs 4) 'Key tasks & outcomes mapped' at 17 msgs 5) 'Digital density canvas filled' at 22 msgs 6) 'Solution consolidated' at 27 msgs
SPI milestones (agentType === 'spi'): 1) 'Persona generated' at 2 msgs 2) 'Interview in progress' at 4 msgs 3) 'Interview completed' at 9 msgs 4) 'Assumptions validated' at 13 msgs
Export type AgentProgress = { agentKey: string; label: string; assistantMessages: number; milestones: Array<{ id: string; label: string; completed: boolean }>; recentTopics: string[] }

Export computeAgentProgress(messages: UnifiedMessage[]): AgentProgress[] — one entry per agent key. assistantMessages counts where role === 'assistant' or role === 'model' AND agentType matches (trend-mapper matches agentType == null). recentTopics = last 3 user messages for that agent trimmed to 60 chars.

Export computeNextStep(progress: AgentProgress[]): { agentKey: string; agentLabel: string; action: string } | null — follows FUND II arc (Trend Mapper → Value Designer → SPI). Returns first agent that has fewer than max milestones completed with a helpful action string. Returns null if all milestones complete.
Typecheck passes

acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/ProgressPanel.tsx as a 'use client' component

Import and call computeAgentProgress + computeNextStep from @/lib/progress/milestones

Three AgentCard blocks in the scrollable section, one per agent in order: Trend Mapper, Value Designer, SPI

Milestone list: each row is flex items-start gap-1.5 — checkmark char '✓' in text-hud-accent when completed or '○' in text-hud-fg/25 when not, milestone label in text-[10px] font-mono text-hud-fg/70 (completed) or text-hud-fg/35 (incomplete).

Below milestones in each card, render recentTopics inside a
element. text: 'RECENT TOPICS' in text-[9px] font-mono tracking-widest uppercase text-hud-fg/40 cursor-pointer list-none. Each topic as a
